question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(unicorn_count) as average_per_year
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.year_founded,
        COUNT(*) as unicorn_count
    FROM companies_dates c
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON c.company_id = ci.company_id
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON c.company_id = cf.company_id
    WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
      AND ci.industry = 'Fintech'
      AND c.year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY c.year_founded
)
